items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Wins EU Approval For Updated COVID Vaccine Ahead Of 2026 Season
items.summary: European Commission grants marketing authorization for Pfizer and BioNTech’s XFG-adapted COVID-19 vaccine for the 2026-2027 season in the EU.
